reason: The geth-style simulation zeroes BASEFEE when the call omits a gas price. Comparing this result with a target call that returns the block base fee is an RPC simulation difference, not a VM divergence.
catalog_effect: All BASEFEE comparison cells are retained as rpc-simulation in DIFFERENTIAL_MATRIX.md and excluded from CATALOG.md.
